card.name: Reviewer credits and warning-section phrases
card.fires_on: Punctuation or linking words just before a name or standard phrase: after 'Editorial Team' or a reviewer's name in review credits, and in warning text such as 'impair the ability of the patient' or 'Embryo-Fetal Toxicity'.

modes.label: Reviewer credits
modes.description: Colon, comma or the word Team in a 'reviewed by' line just before a doctor's name and degrees.
modes.example: Also reviewed by A.D.A.M. Health Solutions, Ebix, Inc., Editorial Team<<:>> David Zieve, MD, MHA

modes.label: Embryo-fetal toxicity heading
modes.description: The ending of 'Toxicity' in the Embryo-Fetal Toxicity heading, or the period after 'fetal harm'.
modes.example: 5.11 Embryo-Fetal Toxic<<ity>> Based on findings from animals and its mechanism

modes.label: Impaired ability wording
modes.description: 'of' or 'for' in stock phrases about impairing the ability of the patient to do hazardous tasks.
modes.example: Phentermine may impair the ability<< of>> the patient to engage in potentially hazardous activities

card.plain: It marks stock phrases in drug labels and web health pages, such as reviewer credit lines and warnings about fetal harm or impaired ability.
